product_overview: Applination is a self-hosted, AI-assisted job application pipeline that automates job discovery, ranking, tailoring, tracking, and follow-up for a single candidate. It provides a unified web interface for running pipelines, managing applications, reviewing ranked jobs, and maintaining grounded master data.
core_goals: Automate the end-to-end job application workflow from job discovery through follow-up
Ground all generated content in user-provided master data to prevent fabrication
Provide real-time visibility into pipeline runs, logs, and ranked job triage
Enable efficient application tracking, document downloads, exports, and bulk updates
Support inbox-based status updates and reminder workflows for closing the loop
Offer configurable LLM routing, provider selection, and onboarding setup for first-run readiness

features.name: Health
features.description: Provides a simple liveness probe for the backend service.
user_flows: GET /api/health -> Receive 200 with {ok: true} confirming service is alive
GET /api/health during service disruption -> Receive non-200 or unreachable response indicating the app is not healthy

features.name: Runs
features.description: Starts, lists, inspects, streams, logs, and stops daily pipeline runs.
user_flows: POST /api/runs with {dry_run:false,no_pdf:false,no_cache:false} -> Receive 200 with created run record -> GET /api/runs/{run_id} -> Receive 200 with run status and metadata -> GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream -> Receive text/event-stream pipeline progress events
GET /api/runs -> Receive 200 with recent runs ordered newest first -> GET /api/runs/{run_id}/log -> Receive 200 with log text and log path
POST /api/runs/{run_id}/stop for an active run -> Receive 200 with updated cancelled run record
POST /api/runs/{run_id}/stop for a missing run -> Receive 404 Not Found
GET /api/runs/{run_id}/stream for an unknown run -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Applications
features.description: Manages generated applications with CRUD-style access, document downloads, status updates, bulk actions, and CSV export.
user_flows: GET /api/applications?run_id=123&status=generated -> Receive 200 with matching application array -> GET /api/applications/{app_id} -> Receive 200 with full application details -> PATCH /api/applications/{app_id} with {status:"applied",notes:"Submitted"} -> Receive 200 with updated application
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/download?doc=resume -> Receive 200 with generated file download and friendly filename
POST /api/applications/bulk with application ids and {status:"archived"} -> Receive 200 with updated application array
POST /api/applications/export with a subset of ids -> Receive 200 with text/csv export
PATCH /api/applications/{app_id} with invalid status value -> Receive 422 validation error
GET /api/applications/{app_id}/download?doc=cover when file is missing -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Ranked jobs (triage and cross-run dedup)
features.description: Shows the scored job pool for a run and supports dismissing or rescuing jobs across runs.
user_flows: GET /api/runs/{run_id}/ranked?only=selected -> Receive 200 with ranked jobs filtered to selected roles

POST /api/ranked/{ranked_id}/dismiss with {dismissed:true} -> Receive 200 with updated ranked job marked dismissed -> GET /api/runs/{run_id}/ranked?only=dismissed -> Receive 200 showing the dismissed job
POST /api/ranked/{ranked_id}/generate -> Receive 200 with a new run_id for rescued application generation
GET /api/runs/{run_id}/ranked?only=invalid -> Receive 422 invalid filter value
POST /api/ranked/{ranked_id}/generate for an already generated job -> Receive 409 Already generated
POST /api/ranked/{ranked_id}/dismiss for a missing ranked job -> Receive 404 Not Found

features.name: Inbox sync (close the loop)
features.description: Checks inbox configuration, validates Gmail connectivity, and syncs recruiter replies to update application statuses.
user_flows: GET /api/inbox/status -> Receive 200 with configuration state, masked email, scan window, and sync metadata
POST /api/inbox/test with inbox credentials configured -> Receive 200 with {ok:true} confirming IMAP connectivity
POST /api/inbox/sync with {days:7} and valid Gmail credentials -> Receive 200 with scanned, matched, classified, updates, and skipped_low_confidence counts
POST /api/inbox/sync when inbox.email or inbox.app_password is missing -> Receive 400 Not configured
POST /api/inbox/test when login fails -> Receive 400 Not configured or login failed

features.name: Reminders (calendar feed and digest)
features.description: Serves an iCalendar feed and supports previewing or sending a daily digest email.
user_flows: GET /api/calendar.ics -> Receive 200 with a valid text/calendar document beginning with BEGIN:VCALENDAR
GET /api/reminders/status -> Receive 200 with email capability, digest flag, and reminder counts
GET /api/reminders/digest/preview -> Receive 200 with subject, html, text, and empty flag without sending email
POST /api/reminders/digest/send with inbox credentials configured -> Receive 200 with sent:true and recipient address
POST /api/reminders/digest/send when inbox.email or inbox.app_password is missing -> Receive 400 Not configured

features.name: Stats
features.description: Aggregates run and application metrics for dashboard reporting.
user_flows: GET /api/stats -> Receive 200 with aggregate counts, score distributions, and timing metrics
GET /api/stats when there is no data -> Receive 200 with zeroed or empty statistics payload

features.name: Config and master data
features.description: Reads and writes config.yaml and exposes master data content for resume, bio, and stories.
user_flows: GET /api/config -> Receive 200 with raw config.yaml text
PUT /api/config with valid YAML text -> Receive 200 ok -> GET /api/config -> Receive updated config text
PUT /api/config with malformed YAML -> Receive 400 Invalid YAML
GET /api/master-data/resume -> Receive 200 with resume.yaml text
GET /api/master-data/bio -> Receive 200 with bio.md text
GET /api/master-data/stories -> Receive 200 with story array

features.name: Ops (providers and LLM routing)
features.description: Lists configured LLM providers, exposes workflow routing, and compares two runs.
user_flows: GET /api/providers -> Receive 200 with provider connectivity and model configuration status
GET /api/llm-config -> Receive 200 with structured per-workflow LLM routing configuration
GET /api/compare?a=101&b=102 -> Receive 200 with side-by-side run comparison metrics
GET /api/compare?a=missing&b=102 -> Receive 404 when a run is missing
GET /api/compare?a=abc&b=102 -> Receive 400 for invalid run id input

features.name: Onboarding
features.description: Reports whether initial setup is complete and what steps remain before the app can run.
user_flows: GET /api/onboarding/status -> Receive 200 with onboarded, marked_complete, can_run, and step checklist
GET /api/onboarding/status after completing setup -> Receive 200 showing can_run true and no missing steps
GET /api/onboarding/status on a fresh install -> Receive 200 showing missing provider/contact/resume/setup requirements

features.name: Prepwork (Coach, Interview, Essay)
features.description: Creates grounded coaching sessions and exposes saved answer history for interview and application preparation.
user_flows: POST /api/chat/sessions with {mode:"chat",application_id:123} -> Receive 200 with created chat session -> GET /api/chat/sessions -> Receive 200 with session list including the new session -> GET /api/chat/answers?application_id=123 -> Receive 200 with saved answers for that application
POST /api/chat/sessions with {mode:"interview"} -> Receive 200 with created mock interview session
POST /api/chat/sessions with invalid mode value -> Receive 422 validation error
GET /api/chat/answers with no matching records -> Receive 200 with an empty saved answer array

features.name: Ranked jobs (triage and cross-run dedup)
features.description: Full scored job pool per run with an auto-selected flag. Rescue (generate) a non-selected job, or dismiss a job so it is excluded from future runs via the cross-run dedup set keyed by company and title.

endpoints.description: List a run scored pool; filter via only=all, selected, rejected, generated, or dismissed. Invalid only value returns 422.
Mark a ranked job dismissed or undismissed (body has dismissed boolean); 404 when missing. Dismissed jobs are kept out of future runs.
Rescue/generate an application for a non-selected job; 404 missing, 409 already generated, 400 no stored description. May trigger LLM generation.

features.name: Inbox sync (close the loop)
features.description: Read recruiter replies over IMAP (Gmail App Password, no OAuth), classify each via the LLM, and apply conservative forward-only status transitions. Status, connectivity test, and sync endpoints. Disabled by default; returns 400 when not configured.

endpoints.description: Report whether inbox creds are configured, the enabled flag, masked email, scan_days, last_sync, and auto_update_status. Never errors.

response_schema.200: configured, enabled, email_masked, scan_days, last_sync, auto_update_status

endpoints.description: Verify IMAP connectivity; 400 when not configured or login fails.
Scan inbox and update application statuses. Body has optional days number. Returns 400 when inbox.email/app_password are not set. With valid creds this reaches Gmail and the LLM.

Send the digest via SMTP. Returns 400 when inbox.email/app_password are not configured; with creds it sends a real email.

known_limitations.impact: All endpoints are open; the app is single-tenant and assumes a trusted localhost.

known_limitations.issue: Several endpoints trigger expensive or outward-facing side effects
known_limitations.location: server/runs.py POST /api/runs, server/ranked.py generate, server/inbox.py sync, server/reminders.py digest send, server/chat.py messages/essay
known_limitations.impact: Real LLM/job-board calls, Gmail reads, and outbound email. Tests should exercise contracts, validation, and the not-configured 400 error paths rather than triggering real effects.

known_limitations.issue: Inbox sync and digest send require Gmail credentials in config.yaml
known_limitations.impact: Without inbox.email and inbox.app_password these endpoints return 400 by design; the calendar feed and digest preview still work.

known_limitations.issue: Cross-run dedup excludes already-applied or dismissed jobs only on the web path
known_limitations.impact: The CLI entry point passes no excluded_keys (DB-agnostic engine), so dedup applies to web-triggered runs.
